title: Bound on Increment Counts
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, and let $k$ be its number of work tapes. Write $H$ for the number of head descriptors and $W=H+3k+1$. For every increment-count identifier $c$, its associated count is at most $4W$.
